source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Jessica,

Thank you for the time you've put into Milestones 1 and 2. After a thorough review, our editorial team has identified concerns that we need to raise with you directly.

**Leftover instructional text:** Milestone 1 includes a note at the top with direct usage instructions ("delete or edit the question in suggesting mode... then paste the comment as your rationale") — scaffolding from an AI workflow that appears to have been left in by mistake.

**A reference to nonexistent content:** The document and the text in the manuscript refer to a "book-wide note on the first page," which does not actually appear anywhere in the document.

**Turnaround time:** Milestone 2 — five full chapters — was submitted within roughly one day, which isn't consistent with the depth of original analysis this work requires.

**AI-detection results:** Independent tools flagged Milestone 2 content in the 75–90% range.

Your contract permits limited AI-assisted tools for spelling, grammar, research, outlining, translation, and editorial support, provided the final manuscript reflects your own original work and professional judgment. Based on the observations above, the submitted material does not appear to meet that condition.

Taking all of this into account, we won't be moving forward with this project. We appreciate your interest in the role and the effort you put in, and we wish you the best going forward.

Thank you.
